actions.action: Move plant to the brightest window (south or west facing)
If light is insufficient, set up a clip-on full-spectrum LED grow light on a 12-hour timer
Rotate the pot a quarter turn each week
Check soil moisture 2 inches down before watering
Water only when soil is fully dry
Cut the top 2-3 inches of the stem with clean scissors or a knife
Let the cutting callus for 2-3 days
Plant the callused cutting in dry succulent mix
Water the cutting lightly after about a week

reason: The answer correctly identifies etiolation and recommends more light plus beheading and propagating the top, matching the thread's fix (it does not mention leaf propagation), and nothing in it is harmful.
